robots.name: Orbit Simulator
robots.description: Launch satellites into orbit. Adjust altitude, inclination, eccentricity. See Kepler's laws in action. 3D Earth view.

robots.name: Hohmann Transfer
robots.description: Plan orbital transfers between planets. Calculate delta-v, travel time, launch windows. Interactive solar system view.

robots.name: Rocket Equation
robots.description: Tsiolkovsky's rocket equation visualized. Adjust mass ratio, exhaust velocity. See why rockets are so hard.

robots.name: Solar System
robots.description: Interactive 3D solar system. Planets orbit in real proportions. Zoom from Mercury to Pluto. Time controls.

robots.name: Constellation Designer
robots.description: Design satellite constellations for global coverage. Starlink-style walker patterns. See coverage maps.

robots.name: Re-entry Physics
robots.description: Simulate atmospheric re-entry. Heat shield physics, drag, G-forces. Adjust entry angle — too steep = burn up, too shallow = skip off.

robots.name: Gravity Simulator
robots.description: N-body gravity sandbox. Place stars, planets, moons. Watch orbits form, collisions happen, systems evolve.

robots.name: Launch Window
robots.description: Calculate optimal launch windows between Earth and Mars. Porkchop plots, synodic periods, C3 energy.
